principle: FACILITY TYPE != FACILITY DESIGN/CLASS != INDIVIDUAL FACILITY != CURRENT OWNER != CURRENT OPERATOR
rules: A facility's physical design can outlive changes of ownership or operation.
A captured, leased or jointly-operated facility does not change physical design identity merely because control changes.
Individual facilities may diverge from their baseline design through refits, damage, expansion or mission-specific conversion.
Facility registry/designation is not a universal chronological numbering system.
Current operator and sovereign territory are separate facts.
